Tests document structure with DOCX heading-driven nesting

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/docx/fake.docx\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].document)

asyncio.run(main())
```
